title: Be a registered professional engineer
what: Carry out professional engineering services only as a practising (registered) professional engineer, or under one's direct supervision.

sources.title: Professional Engineers Act 2002 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person who is not a practising professional engineer must not carry out professional engineering services.
